multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Many women, including the Widow Quin, become attracted to Christy.
Christy impresses the village women by his victory in a donkey race.
Pegeen laments betraying and losing Christy.
Christy apologizes to his father and embraces him.
Shawn suggests he and Pegeen get married soon, but she spurns him.
Flaherty praises Christy for his boldness.
